Four students were asked to match the function with the appearance of some cell structures in an animal cell. The functions were listed by number.
The DNA of typical prokaryotes is naked and circular. Which statement describes how the DNA of eukaryotes differs from the DNA of typical prokaryotes?

options.A: Only DNA of eukaryotes has a nuclear envelope around it and is a double helix.
options.B: Only DNA of eukaryotes has a nuclear envelope around it and is circular.
options.C: Only DNA of eukaryotes has proteins attached to it and is a double helix.
options.D: Only DNA of eukaryotes has proteins attached to it and is linear.

Which stage of mitosis is correctly described?

options.A: In anaphase chromosomes line up across the equator.
options.C: In prophase chromatids move to opposite poles.
